name: io.github.AindriuB/data-prism
description: Fail-closed privacy layer that pseudonymises enterprise API data for LLM agents and MCP clients.
title: Data Prism

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Bind-mount at least one reviewed DataSourceAdapter/IdentityResolver jar into the loader path (LOADER_PATH=/app/adapters) for every dataprism.sources entry; absent this, DataPrismContractValidator refuses startup with MISSING_SOURCE_ADAPTER.

adapter_jar_host_path.description: Absolute host path to a reviewed DataSourceAdapter/IdentityResolver jar you built and reviewed yourself

adapter_jar_name.description: File name to expose for that jar inside /app/adapters

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Bind-mount a deployment configuration YAML satisfying every required dataprism.* key in docs/configuration.md to the path Spring Boot auto-loads on startup; equivalent to, and combinable with, the DATAPRISM_* environment variables below. Absent both, DataPrismProperties.validate() refuses startup.

config_host_path.description: Absolute host path to your dataprism.* application.yaml

environmentVariables.name: LOADER_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Directory Spring Boot's PropertiesLauncher scans for extension jars; already set to /app/adapters by the image, but startup still fails with MISSING_SOURCE_ADAPTER until you bind-mount a reviewed DataSourceAdapter/IdentityResolver jar there (see the -v arguments above)

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_ISSUER
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2/OIDC issuer that mints the caller's JWT; required for every protected deployment

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_AUDIENCE
environmentVariables.description: Expected JWT audience claim for this deployment; required for every protected deployment

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_JWK_SET_URI
environmentVariables.description: HTTPS JWKS location used to verify caller JWTs; exactly one of this or DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_ISSUER_DISCOVERY_URI is required, never both

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_ISSUER_DISCOVERY_URI
environmentVariables.description: Alternative HTTPS OIDC issuer-discovery location; set this instead of DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_JWK_SET_URI, never both

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_CALLER_CLAIMS_PRINCIPAL
environmentVariables.description: JWT claim name that carries the caller's principal identifier; required, must differ from the roles and investigation claims

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_CALLER_CLAIMS_ROLES
environmentVariables.description: JWT claim name that carries the caller's roles; required, must differ from the principal and investigation claims

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_CALLER_CLAIMS_INVESTIGATION
environmentVariables.description: JWT claim name that carries the trusted investigation/case identifier; required, must differ from the principal and roles claims

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_POLICY_PURPOSES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of permitted purposes; at least one is required

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITYPOLICY_ROLES_INVESTIGATOR
environmentVariables.description: Example only — declare DATAPRISM_SECURITYPOLICY_ROLES_<ROLE> per operator-defined role (no underscore between SECURITY and POLICY: Spring Boot's map-key enumeration under a hyphenated dataprism.security-policy.roles.<role> segment only binds the concatenated prefix, verified by binding this property directly against Spring Boot 3.5.16), a comma-separated list of known MCP tool capabilities; at least one role-to-capability mapping is required

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Name of the reviewed privacy profile implementation to apply; required

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_SCOPE_LIFETIME
environmentVariables.description: Positive duration (e.g. 8h) a privacy scope's synthetic identities remain valid; required

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Identifier of the pinned HMAC key used to derive synthetic identities; required

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE
environmentVariables.description: Name of the environment variable holding the HMAC key material; exactly one of this or DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_PROVIDER_REFERENCE is required, never both, and never a literal key value

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_PROVIDER_REFERENCE
environmentVariables.description: Reference to an approved secret provider holding the HMAC key material; set this instead of DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE, never both

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_AUDIT_SINK
environmentVariables.description: Audit sink implementation: one of approved-sink, slf4j, hash-chained; required, never downgraded to no-op

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_AUDIT_WRITER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Writer/instance identity recorded on every audit entry; required

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_AUDIT_FILE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the durable, hash-chained audit log; required when DATAPRISM_AUDIT_SINK=hash-chained, refused as MISSING_AUDIT_FILE_PATH if absent for that sink, ignored otherwise

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_METRICS_SINK
environmentVariables.description: Metrics sink binding, currently only micrometer; required in production, never the framework no-op

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_TOPOLOGY
environmentVariables.description: Cluster read-budget topology: embedded (shared across the cluster) or single-node (enforced per process); required, never defaulted

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SOURCES_CUSTOMER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Example only — declare DATAPRISM_SOURCES_<NAME>_BASE_URL (HTTPS) per configured source; at least one source, each with its own reviewed DataSourceAdapter bean, is required

environmentVariables.name: DATAPRISM_SOURCES_CUSTOMER_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Example only — declare DATAPRISM_SOURCES_<NAME>_TIMEOUT (positive duration) per configured source; required alongside its base URL
